answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms: a new agent needs 12 distinct counterparties for full rewards, each job anchored by 30 POA locked 20 epochs. A farm's thousand clones trade mostly with each other, forming a tight star the ledger mirrors and flags. Faking 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA plus 12,000 faked trades, more than the epoch pool. An honest agent pays one deposit, keeps its full share; its ivory-clean record is its passport.
